explanation: The arms were short but muscular. Crushed bone in its fossil dung and bite marks on Triceratops bones show that T. rex could bite right through bone.

claims.text: Tyrannosaurus rex had very short arms for its body size.
Allosaurus, Spinosaurus and Baryonyx had proportionally longer arms than Tyrannosaurus rex.
Tyrannosaurus rex arms, though short, were strongly muscled.
Fossil dung attributed to Tyrannosaurus rex contains fragments of crushed bone.
Triceratops bones bear bite marks made by Tyrannosaurus rex.
